note: Curated buy-list. Prices are CNY estimates (educated guesses unless confidence=listed). Optional fields per item: target_cny = price threshold (dashboard flags crossed targets); checked = YYYY-MM-DD date you verified the price live (upgrades confidence to VERIFIED within 30 days).

items.name: AMD Ryzen 9 7900X (used, Xianyu)
items.why: 12C/24T, clean IOMMU groups, AM5 upgrade path to 9000X3D

items.name: X670E board - ProArt Creator / Steel Legend (open box)
items.why: PCIe x8/x8 bifurcation + proven IOMMU for GPU passthrough, 10GbE on ProArt

items.name: 128GB DDR5-5600 (4x32GB) EXPO
items.why: Room for KV-cache offload + 8-10 service containers without swap

items.name: RTX 3090 24GB blower-mod (used, Huaqiangbei)
items.why: 24GB VRAM: local 70B-class LLMs + game VM passthrough. Test VRAM before paying

items.name: RTX 3060 12GB (used) - anti-cheat direct box
items.why: Runs bare-metal Windows for kernel anti-cheat games the VM refuses

items.name: 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe
items.why: VM images + local model weights

items.name: 8TB enterprise HDD, used (ZFS mirror pair)
items.why: 16TB raw = 8TB mirrored for Jellyfin library + camera archives

items.name: 1200W 80+ Gold ATX 3.0 (Seasonic/Corsair) - NEW ONLY
items.why: Safety part. Dual-GPU transient spikes need ATX 3.0 headroom

items.name: Wide tower case - 2 GPU + 360mm radiator
items.why: Airflow for 24/7 duty; fits blower 3090 without cooking the board

items.name: 360mm AIO liquid cooler
items.why: Sustained AI + gaming loads on a 7900X

items.name: AMD BC-250 16GB GDDR6 compute board (used, Xianyu)
items.why: Ex-mining PS5 APU: 6C Zen2 + 24 RDNA2 CU, 16GB GDDR6 shared @ 448GB/s, 220W. Node A = 2x (~32GB), Node B = 3x (~48GB); llama.cpp Vulkan + SMU governor. Test each board and GDDR6 airflow before paying

items.name: 2x node carrier hosts (used board + CPU + 32GB, Xianyu)
items.why: Skeleton per BC-250 node (A and B): carries the cards via risers plus the ConnectX-3 10GbE NIC - cheap secondary-market parts, no name-brand needed

items.name: Mellanox ConnectX-3 10GbE SFP+ + DAC (x3)
items.why: About 100-150 CNY per card on Xianyu; ~1.1 GB/s for cross-node llama.cpp RPC / KV-cache transfer and NAS traffic. 3 cards: Node A, Node B, core host

items.name: TP-Link TL-ST1008F 8-port 10G SFP+ switch
items.why: 10GbE backbone for Node A / Node B / core NAS - 1GbE (~110 MB/s) is too slow for inter-node LLM traffic; 8 ports leaves room to grow

items.name: 1600-2000W redundant server PSU (1+1) + 12V breakout board
items.why: Feeds 5x 220W BC-250 spikes via mining-style 12V breakout - the one used-power gamble; load-test before trusting it with the nodes

items.name: 4U / open mining frame + 12U-18U server cabinet
items.why: BC-250 boards are non-standard 305mm mining boards - open-frame mounting in a real cabinet keeps the rack tidy and the cables short

items.name: High-static 120mm fan set (Delta 4000+ RPM class)
items.why: BC-250 heatsinks need forced air - point fans at the GDDR6 too (it runs extremely hot); wired directly to node power

items.name: 1500VA UPS - NEW ONLY
items.why: ZFS and 24/7 cameras must survive outages; never buy used batteries

items.name: Used OEM tower (Dell/HP) for the 3060 box
items.why: Second physical machine - boots real Windows, no hypervisor in sight

items.name: Xiaomi Mi Box x2 (TV Moonlight / Jellyfin endpoints)
items.why: TV endpoints replace mini-PCs: decode Moonlight/Jellyfin at the TV (living room + main bedroom) - zero cables back to the server

items.name: Premium wireless KB+mouse set (main stations)
items.why: Primary desks - smooth daily driver matters most here

items.name: Wireless KB+mouse set (light stations)
items.why: Kids/future tablets stations - cheap but consistent

items.name: 2.5GbE managed switch + Cat6 runs
items.why: Ethernet per room beats Wi-Fi for Moonlight latency - run cables before furniture lands

items.name: PoE camera set: 4 cams + 8ch NVR (local, no cloud)
items.why: Local-only recording kills monthly subscription fees - feeds the independence goal

items.name: 3-seater sofa
items.why: Heaviest line - measure doorways/elevators first. Quality tier beats local at half price

items.name: Service / coffee tables
items.why: Pairs with sofas; ships in the same crate - near-zero marginal freight

items.name: Kitchen accessories bundle (organizers, knives, utensils)
items.why: Modular: cut this whole line if the kitchen plan changes - that is the cancel-anything design

items.name: Bathroom accessories set x2 bathrooms
items.why: Fixtures, holders, mirrors - classic half-price China category

items.name: Art pieces + sculptures
items.why: Light, high value-to-weight - the cheapest freight per SAR of visual impact

items.name: Bed frame + premium ergonomic mattress + nightstands (Foshan Lecong)
items.why: Main bedroom set from Lecong market: frame + mattress + 2 nightstands. Large wardrobe deliberately EXCLUDED - floor space and budget headroom matter more

items.name: Dimmable ambient lighting (bedroom + living)
items.why: Bedroom decor bundle with the curtains: smart-dimmable, roughly half local price

items.name: Made-to-measure curtains (main bedroom + living)
items.why: Bedroom decor bundle: curtains + dimmable lighting together land at the planned 1,100 CNY

items.name: Robot vacuum (Roborock/Xiaomi tier)
items.why: Light electronics with no local price advantage - earns its freight

items.name: Smart home kit (switches, sensors, hub)
items.why: Feeds the local-automation goal; works with the Proxmox stack via Zigbee

items.name: Distinctive gadget bundle (Anker/eufy tier)
items.why: The little stuff that has no local equivalent - fill the crate gaps
